title: Step 9 architecture screening v1 (MASTER_CONTEXT §37 step 9; founder approved 2026-09-27)
purpose: Screen one-at-a-time architecture changes to the fixed small model on the frozen Frontier Tokenizer v1, graded by evaluation harness v1 (D-042), to choose a PROVISIONAL architecture baseline for GPU bring-up. Toy scale (transformer body ~1.05M of 5.26M parameters): results are screening evidence only and must be re-validated in the GPU scaling experiments (step 11).
pre_registered: 2026-09-27, before any EXP-032 result existed. Changing any field below after results exist requires a new experiment id.
checkpoint_note: The FINAL checkpoint is graded (fixed step budget). The trainer's 'best' checkpoint is chosen with the held-out split, which is the evaluation suite, so grading it would let the test data select the model.

baseline.name: baseline
baseline.description: the EXP-B model unchanged: learned positions, SwiGLU (ffn_mult 4), RMSNorm, 4 query / 4 key-value heads, tied embeddings, lr 3e-3
baseline.reuse_note: EXP-029's mark_aware-32768 cells are this exact baseline (same config, data, steps and seeds). They are reused only if their last/ checkpoint exists and their saved config matches; otherwise the baseline is trained fresh.

variants.name: rope
variants.question: Rotary positions instead of a learned position table. The learned table cannot extend beyond block_size, so longer context later needs RoPE or similar.

variants.name: gelu
variants.question: GELU feed-forward instead of SwiGLU. ffn_mult 6.0 makes the body parameter count exactly equal (1,049,728).

variants.name: gqa2
variants.question: Grouped-query attention with 2 key-value heads (halves the inference KV cache; -65,536 parameters).

lr_check.question: Is lr 3e-3 near-optimal for the baseline at this budget? Every comparison above uses 3e-3.

repro_check.question: Does retraining the baseline reproduce identical weights (tensor-by-tensor)?

decision_rules.superiority: delta = variant - baseline in bits-per-byte from eval_compare (paired document bootstrap, 95%). BETTER if the CI upper bound < 0 AND every variant seed beats every baseline seed. WORSE if the CI lower bound > 0 AND every baseline seed beats every variant seed. Otherwise NO DETECTABLE DIFFERENCE AT THIS SCALE.
decision_rules.non_inferiority: ACCEPTABLE if the CI upper bound of delta <= margin_bpb; NOT SHOWN otherwise. The superiority verdict is also reported.
decision_rules.lr_check: LR-CONFOUNDED if an alternative learning rate improves the seed-1337 baseline by more than the baseline's across-seed standard deviation. Then the night-2 confirmation (separate approval) re-tests at the better learning rate.
decision_rules.repro_check: IDENTICAL if every weight tensor of the retrained model equals the reference run's exactly; otherwise DIFFERENT (reported with the largest absolute difference).
decision_rules.adoption: Only BETTER (or ACCEPTABLE for efficiency changes) results are candidates for the provisional architecture decision (D-043). NO DETECTABLE DIFFERENCE keeps the current default unless there is a stated prior or efficiency reason, recorded as such.

eval_args_note: Contamination depends only on the suite and training data, which are identical to EXP-031 (0 exact / 0 13-gram overlaps); it is not re-computed per model.
